# Learning spells
You can use a modified infusion altar to teach living creatures how to use spells.
The ritual logic for spell mastery training works exactly the same as the infusion altar. But instead of a catalyst, a living creature is placed on the central altar.
Successfully completing the ritual grants the creature the ability to use the spell, and they also become a subject of scientific interest - allowing you to gain research points by studying them.
# Magical focus
Using spells requires a focus item charged with essence:
You can click the focus against any essence storage (vials, nodes) to absorb essence and charge the focus.
